Mitaka Native preview uses the independently buildable Mitaka macOS core,
derived from the official Mitaka 1.3.1 source code.
This preview is a local development port, not an official Mitaka release.
No astronomical data or images are bundled with this application.

Original components: common/JulianDate.cpp, common/astro/cele_mech.cpp,
common/astro/astrometry.cpp, common/math/vector3.h, common/astro/cf96.cpp,
Mitaka/mtk_orbital_element.cpp, Mitaka/mtk_planet_position.cpp,
Mitaka/mtk_planet_orientation.cpp, Mitaka/mtk_lunar_pos.cpp,
Mitaka/mtk_satellite_orientation.cpp,
Mitaka/mtk_stars.cpp, Mitaka/mtk_constellation.cpp, Mitaka/mtk_trajectory.cpp,
Mitaka/mtk_planetarium.cpp, Mitaka/mtk_galaxies.cpp,
common/astro/astrometry.h, common/astro/constellation.cpp,
common/text/unicode.cpp, Mitaka/mtk_planets.cpp, Mitaka/mtk_draw_struct.h.

2026 modifications: C++17 portable astronomy and validated catalog readers,
an AppKit user interface, equatorial and horizon sky views, reversible time
playback, local state and image export, projection output, and a Lua helper.
Source provenance and modifications are documented in native/core/*_PROVENANCE.md.
The software license does not grant redistribution rights for astronomical
datasets. Those remain subject to their individual terms.

Lua 5.4.9 is built from the official source archive and statically linked
into the separate MitakaScript helper, not the astronomy core.
Source: https://www.lua.org/ftp/lua-5.4.9.tar.gz
SHA-256: 2335b6c582a52654f94612bf10d2f4672805d05329aa6568b1d8cd9e5c6fb8e6
The build verifies the checksum of the bundled source archive and targets macOS 13.0 or later for arm64 or x86_64. No external Lua dylib or
Homebrew installation is required to run the built application.
Lua copyright and MIT permission are reproduced in the accompanying
LUA_LICENSE.txt, installed in the application's Resources directory.

This application provides partial Mitaka Plus 1.5.4 functionality, not full
binary, scripting-language, host-API, or user-interface compatibility.
Compatibility evidence and limitations are recorded in PLUS_FEATURE_MATRIX.md
and native/gui/SCRIPTING.md in the source repository.
